It still has some defensive capabilities, but its usefulness has been worn down by time.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 3 |durability = 16 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Rusty Shield}} Rusty Shields are old [[Shield]]s that were once potentially used by the [[Knight of Hyrule|Knights of Hyrule]]. Though they still offer some defense, a majority of their usefulness has been lost to time. These Shields belong to the [[Rusty Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of deteriorated [[Weapon]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 169}} They can commonly be found abandoned in [[Hyrule Field]] and [[East Necluda]]. If a [[Rock Octorok]] inhales a Rusty Shield, it will chew it before spitting out a cleaned counterpart. The Shield has a 50% chance to be a [[Traveler's Shield]], a 35% chance to be a [[Soldier's Shield]], a 10% chance to be a [[Knight's Shield]], and a 5% chance to be a [[Royal Shield]]. Being made of metal, Rusty Shields will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They will also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Finally, unlike wooden Shields, Rusty Shields will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_021" |Life = 16 |GuardPower = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 9 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 3 |durability = 16 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Rusty Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Rusty Gear * Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Rusty Gear, Shields |items= BotW, TotK }}
